posts.headline: Statistic
posts.body:
Women touch their face an average of 23 times per hour.
Each touch transfers bacteria and causes breakouts.
posts.cta: Stop touching your face — 23x per hour!

posts.headline: Statistic
posts.body:
People who sleep 6–8 hours have a 48% lower risk of heart disease.
Sleep is cardiovascular medicine.
posts.cta: Sleep duration is a heart health factor.
